title: How long a borrower stays in the book

coverage.note: Spells are runs of consecutive PANEL quarters (the 30 quarters actually present), not calendar quarters. 2019Q3 and 2022Q1 are missing, so a borrower present either side of a gap is counted as continuous; the measure is therefore an upper bound on true continuous tenure. Borrower identity is the raw filing string, so a rename breaks a spell and inflates the count. Both panels bin on the LONGEST-EVER spell in the window, not on tenure as at the latest quarter: a borrower with a long early run who returned recently sits in a high band. The left panel is an equal-weighted count of names over all 1,331 borrowers ever in the window; the right panel is fair-value weighted over the 593 borrowers held in 2026Q2 only.
